NEWSROOM BRIEF

Capital Chronicle's ECI record: a smaller quarterly rise

Capital Chronicle's retained Employment Cost Index record shows civilian compensation up 0.8% over the quarter after 0.9%, while the annual rate stays at 3.4%.

What to watch: Capital Chronicle's accompanying research records report no directional view on dollar/yen and no directional view on gold after the Employment Cost Index.

Full brief: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/pending-publication-b16af3c7b500a1f2
